description: The verification process does not use a reasonable method to match information provided by the consumer with information already maintained by the business. CCPA requires verification to reasonably match the consumer's identity using at least two or three data points depending on the sensitivity of the request, preventing unauthorized access while not creating undue barriers.
applicability: Privacy request verification systems Consumer identity verification workflows Access and deletion request handlers Account-based authentication systems Password-protected consumer accounts Multi-factor authentication implementations

metadata.detection_notes: Review CCPA compliance documentation and controls for VERIFY requirements.
